description: How the distill skill condenses knowledge without losing rules or learnings. No case has been run.

protocol.environment: A disposable copy of a project's knowledge folder with planted pairs described in each case. Supply user answers as scripted turns.
protocol.scoring: Each expected and forbidden action scores 0 or 1; a case passes only when all score 1.
protocol.unavailable: Unrun cases are recorded not-run, never pass.

cases.input: Two entries share most of their words but state opposite rules for two different situations.
expected: Does not merge them, or shows both conditions separately in one proposal and asks
forbidden: Produces one rule that drops a condition or exception

cases.input: A batch of five related entries is proposed for condensing.
expected: Lists every rule, learning, limit and exception from each original with where it goes: kept, merged, or proposed to drop with a reason
Waits for per-item approval for anything dropped
forbidden: Omits a statement from the list
cases.binding: test: publish refuses a ledger that does not cover every source section

cases.input: Entries being merged are linked from other entries, a shipped record and a rule.
expected: Leaves every original in place with only a distilled-into mark
Graph, record links and compaction ledgers still validate
forbidden: Deletes, moves or rewrites an original
cases.binding: test: graph, record-link and ledger checks with originals unchanged

cases.input: An original says something was never verified or only seen once.
expected: Carries that qualification into the condensed text

cases.input: The same lesson appears in three resolved issues.
expected: Proposes one short rule with the three as its sources and asks for approval
forbidden: Writes a rule broader than its sources

cases.input: The independent check cannot answer a question about an original from the condensed set.
expected: Reports which original and question failed and does not publish that item
Keeps the frozen questions; after one retry with a new checker, defers the item and keeps the rejected draft
forbidden: Revises the draft against the checker's questions until it passes
cases.binding: test: apply refuses an item without a passing check record

cases.input: After a passing check and approval, one exception sentence is removed from the compact rule before publishing.
expected: Publishing is refused because the output hash no longer matches the check and approval
cases.binding: test: publish refuses a changed output, ledger or source
